provenance: Trained in-process via models.yin2022_rrformer.runner.run_fold on the author Stage-1 protocol (global NSELoss pretraining + full-network per-basin Adam MSE fine-tuning); scored with metrics.metrics.calculate_all_metrics; halted before Stage 2 per Stage-1 +/-0.01 hard gate pending lead Option 2 decision.

published.source: Yin et al. (2022), J. Hydrol. 609, 127781, Section 4.1 (p. 6), Fig. 4a & Tables 5-6 (RR-Former 7-day mean NSE = 0.8265 median / 0.7904 mean, 673 basins, Daymet, 2000-2014 eval)

notes: Clean-room faithful Stage-1 probe (seed 601, 671 CAMELS basins present in camels_671_1980_2014.npz, Daymet 5 dynamic channels, use_static=False, past_len=15, pred_len=7, global NSELoss pretraining up to 120 epochs x 1024 batches with early stop at ep 79 at best_val_nse=0.6890 + full-network per-basin Adam MSE fine-tuning up to 200 epochs, 10,586.2 s on 2x NVIDIA T4): Day-1 median NSE (nse1_median) reaches 0.8294 (mean 0.7881, delta +0.0029 vs 0.8265 median / -0.0023 vs 0.7904 mean), while the 7-day mean NSE (test_nse_mean_median) is 0.7723 (mean 0.7206; per-lead medians Days 1..7 = [0.8294, 0.7896, 0.7731, 0.7655, 0.7576, 0.7552, 0.7422]; Day-1 median KGE = 0.8568; 9 basins <= 0; 0 NaNs). Because 7-day test_nse_mean_median = 0.7723 is outside the +/-0.01 Stage-1 hard pass gate around 0.8265 (delta = -0.0542), RR-Former was halted prior to Stage-2 re-training; the prior 531-basin Stage-1 Zarr store (gs://camels-us-mip/stage1_author_reproductions/yin2022_rrformer.zarr) and gauged__lagged_streamflow.json entries were left untouched pending lead review.
